description: Check whether the user has confirmed a claim created with claim_app. While the user hasn't confirmed yet it returns {status: 'pending'} — wait a few seconds and call again (the link stays valid for 7 days). Once claimed it returns the REAL app id, the install snippet and the hosted privacy-policy URL: replace any placeholder (YOUR_APP_ID) snippet with the real one.

code.description: The claim code returned by claim_app.

name: get_claim_status
title: Get claim status
